name: Census API (not used)
notes: https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5 rejected unauthenticated requests (X-DataWebAPI-KeyError, redirect to missing_key.html) on 2026-09-26. The pipeline reads the Census Bureau's public 2024 ACS 5-year table-based summary files instead.

name: Pittsburgh neighborhood boundaries
publisher: City of Pittsburgh, via Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center
license: Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) on the WPRDC neighborhoods dataset
notes: All 90 official city neighborhood polygons. Their union defines the city coverage boundary; largest overlap assigns each retained parcel.

name: Allegheny County parcel boundaries
license: License not specified on the county MapServer or on the WPRDC parcel-boundary dataset.
notes: Geometry, PIN, map-block-lot, and calculated acreage for parcels in the neighborhood bounding boxes. Clipped to neighborhood polygons in a later step. No owner fields are on this layer. The organizers' dataset URL returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-26. The live WPRDC page is https://data.wprdc.org/dataset/allegheny-county-parcel-boundaries1. Polygons were read from the county MapServer.
caveat: Geometry and assessment records may update on different schedules; validate parcel IDs.

name: Allegheny County property assessments
publisher: Allegheny County Office of Property Assessments, redistributed by the Western Pennsylvania Regional Data Center
notes: Land use, lot area, year built, living area, and sale fields streamed from the county datastore with an explicit safe-column list; only city parcel IDs are retained. Owner names are not in this extract. CHANGENOTICE address fields are never requested or written. Assessed value is not read and is not treated as market value.
caveat: Assessment fields can be stale or missing; do not treat assessed value as market value.

name: City of Pittsburgh zoning districts
license: License not specified on the WPRDC zoning resource
notes: District code zon_new and the district title. Which housing types are allowed is NOT taken from this layer. That stub lives in zoning/districts.json and needs expert review. The organizers' dataset URL returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-26. The live WPRDC page is https://data.wprdc.org/dataset/zoning. Polygons were read from the city feature service.
caveat: Map alone is insufficient: overlays, definitions, exceptions, and review rules matter.

name: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer flood zones
notes: Effective NFHL layer 28, limited to Special Flood Hazard Areas (SFHA_TF = T) and 0.2-percent zones (ZONE_SUBTY contains 0.2). Zone X minimal-hazard polygons are not downloaded; no overlap with the queried zones is scored as minimal mapped flood hazard. The FEMA HTML page returned HTTP 403 to this client; the MapServer query is the file that was read.
caveat: Not a substitute for survey or flood determination; map amendments may matter.

name: Pittsburgh Steep Slopes (25% or greater)
license: License not specified on the WPRDC steep-slope resource
notes: Polygons of slopes 25 percent or greater inside the city neighborhood boxes. Overlap is the measured input. The score uses this as a landslide-risk proxy because the organizers' list has no landslide-inventory layer. It is not a landslide map.
caveat: Derived threshold layer; site engineering requires detailed survey/geotechnical work.

name: Pittsburgh Undermined Areas
license: License not specified on the WPRDC undermined-areas resource
notes: Mine-influence polygons inside the city neighborhood boxes. Overlap is a preliminary screen only.
caveat: Historic mine maps can be incomplete or imprecise; never use alone for safety decisions.

name: ACS 2024 5-year tables B19013, B25064, and B25070
notes: Median household income, median gross rent, and gross rent as a percentage of household income. Filtered to Allegheny County block groups, tracts, and the county summary. https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs5 rejected unauthenticated requests (X-DataWebAPI-KeyError, redirect to missing_key.html) on 2026-09-26. The pipeline reads the Census Bureau's public 2024 ACS 5-year table-based summary files instead.
caveat: Estimates have margins of error; avoid false precision for small areas.

name: Census cartographic block groups, Pennsylvania 2024
notes: 2024 cartographic boundary file cb_2024_42_bg_500k, filtered to Allegheny County, joined to 2024 ACS so the geography vintage matches the statistics. The organizers' list names TIGER/Line; this cartographic file uses the same 2024 GEOIDs and is the file that was joined. NAD83 coordinates are used as WGS84; the difference is small relative to a block group.
caveat: Boundary vintages must match the statistics being joined.

name: Pittsburgh Regional Transit GTFS
license: PRT Developer License Agreement, accepted by downloading the public GTFS zip. See https://www.rideprt.org/business-center/developer-resources/
notes: stops.txt, trips.txt, calendar.txt, calendar_dates.txt, routes.txt, and stop_times.txt. Weekday trip counts use one representative weekday inside the feed's service window. The organizers' dataset URL returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-26. The schedule actually read is the PRT developer GTFS zip. Trip counts are scheduled service, not realized reliability.
caveat: Scheduled service is not the same as realized reliability; agency name may appear historically as Port Authority.

name: Comprehensive Housing Affordability Strategy (CHAS)
publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
notes: 2018-2022 CHAS (released December 2025), Table 8, census tract summary level 140. The equity input is the share of renter households at or below 80% of HAMFI with cost burden greater than 30%, excluding households whose cost burden was not computed. Joined to the parcel on the 11-digit tract GEOID. ACS 2024 B25070 stays a separate rent-burden input. CHAS lags that ACS vintage by several years. Column names are from the 2018-2022 data dictionary.
caveat: Based on multi-year ACS data; releases lag and tables are complex.

name: ACS 2024 5-year table B25003 (tenure)
notes: Renter-occupied share of occupied housing units by census tract, for the displacement screen. Same release and table-based summary file format as the other 2024 tables.
caveat: Estimates have margins of error; avoid false precision for small areas.

name: ACS 2015-2019 5-year table B25064 (median gross rent)
notes: Tract and county median gross rent for 2015-2019, the most recent 5-year period that does not overlap 2020-2024. Read from the sequence-based summary file (sequence 0114, position 60, checked against ACS_5yr_Seq_Table_Number_Lookup.txt) because the table-based format starts with 2021. Nominal dollars; the county change is subtracted so region-wide inflation cancels.
caveat: Estimates have margins of error; avoid false precision for small areas.

name: Census 2020 to 2010 tract relationship file, Pennsylvania
notes: Used only to decide which 2020 tracts can be compared with 2015-2019 ACS rents (2010 tracts). A tract is compared when the 2020 and 2010 tracts share a GEOID and each covers at least 95 percent of the other's land area.
caveat: Boundary vintages must match the statistics being joined.

name: City-Owned Properties
notes: Parcel id, land class, inventory type (for example URA Transfer, Public Sale, Greenway), and current status (for example Available for Sale, Hold for Study). Joined on the county parcel id. The owner column is never requested. Greenways and parks are marked so Find Sites can leave them out. City ownership is not availability.
caveat: Inventory status changes; confirm availability with the City / URA before acting.

name: City of Pittsburgh Property Tax Delinquency
publisher: City of Pittsburgh Department of Finance / WPRDC
notes: Parcel id and number of prior delinquent years only. Joined on the county parcel id. Amounts owed and the billing city are not requested. The parcel file keeps two booleans: listed as delinquent, and delinquent for at least one prior year. City real estate tax only; county and school taxes are separate.
catalog_name: City of Pittsburgh Property Tax Delinquency
caveat: Delinquency can be paid or appealed at any time; it is not a sale or availability signal.

name: Condemned and Dead-End Properties
publisher: City of Pittsburgh Department of Permits, Licenses, and Inspections / WPRDC
notes: Parcel id, property type, and inspection status. Active records only. The City publishes condemned and dead-end as one category, so the parcel file keeps one boolean. The owner column is never requested.
caveat: A condemned building may be occupied, under repair, or in court; it is not an available site.

name: HUD Low-Income Housing Tax Credit (LIHTC) properties
publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
notes: Project name, total units, low-income units, and year placed in service, queried within about 2 km of the city area. Contact and company fields are not requested. Used as nearby affordable-stock context (projects and low-income units within 800 m of a parcel). lihtc.geojson keeps only projects within 800 m of an city parcel. Not a score input.
caveat: Covers LIHTC only, lags recent placements, and does not show units that left the program.

name: HUD Qualified Census Tracts 2026
publisher: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development
notes: Allegheny County tract GEOIDs on HUD's QUALIFIED_CENSUS_TRACTS_2026 layer. Joined on the parcel's 2020 tract. A QCT can raise LIHTC eligible basis; that is a financing fact, not a score input. The layer description text still says 2024.
caveat: Designations change each year; confirm the year that applies to an allocation.

name: Allegheny County Property Sale Transactions
notes: Sale prices in this extract come from sale fields on the property-assessment extract, not from this separate transactions file. The same caveat is applied: only SALECODE 0 / SALEDESC beginning with VALID SALE, price at least $10,000, on or after 2021-09-26. The organizers' URL returned HTTP 404 on 2026-09-26. The live WPRDC page is https://data.wprdc.org/dataset/real-estate-sales.
caveat: Filter using sale-validation codes; many nominal transfers are not arm’s-length sales.

name: OpenStreetMap
license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL)
notes: Raster tiles are the basemap only (https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png). They are not a scored input.
caveat: Completeness varies; comply with ODbL attribution and share-alike requirements.

name: EIA Residential Energy Consumption Survey 2020, Table CE1.2
notes: Northeast census region, average annual site energy per household: single-family detached 120.7, single-family attached 85.4, apartments in 2-4 unit buildings 68.0, apartments in 5+ unit buildings 36.2 million Btu. Used as ratios in the marginal-carbon estimate. Existing homes of all ages; site energy, not emissions.
catalog_name: EIA RECS 2020 (not on the organizers' list)
caveat: Existing-stock averages; new construction under current codes uses less energy.

name: Embodied carbon by residential building form
publisher: Zuluaga & Saxe 2025 (Environ. Res.: Infrastruct. Sustain. 5 035015); Rankin, Arceo, Isin & Saxe 2024 (J. Industrial Ecology 28(3):455-468, https://doi.org/10.1111/jiec.13461)
notes: Only the direction is used: new single-unit dwellings carry more embodied GHG per home than new multi-unit homes (city medians about 79,000-102,000 versus 39,000-60,000 kgCO2e per dwelling in Zuluaga & Saxe). The carbon estimate turns that into a coarse tier (1.0 single-family, 0.6 multi-unit), which is a choice, not a measurement.
catalog_name: Embodied carbon studies (not on the organizers' list)
caveat: Canadian and U.S. city samples; variation within a building form is larger than between forms.

name: EPA EJScreen
notes: Stretch source from the organizers' list. Not joined in this build.
caveat: Screening tool, not a risk assessment; methods and indicator definitions change.

name: Location Affordability Index
notes: Stretch source from the organizers' list. Not joined in this build.
caveat: Modeled estimates depend on household profiles and vintage; not observed household spending.

name: LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics (LODES)
notes: Stretch source from the organizers' list. Not joined in this build. Transit access uses the PRT schedule instead.
caveat: Data are modeled and noise-infused; latest year lags.

name: Opportunity Atlas
notes: Stretch source from the organizers' list. Not joined in this build, and not used to rank people or places as current conditions.
caveat: Historical cohort outcomes are not current neighborhood conditions and should not be used to rank people.
